TEXT: [FI] The vast sky. The white sandy beach. The blue sea.

[FI] On a certain day during the few remaining days of 
summer vacation, we came down to the beach.

[FI] Stepping onto the sand that's like a heated frying 
pan, it made me worry whether my own beach 
sandals would melt.

[FI] In the midst of the uninterrupted sunlight shining 
down...
[FI] I waited for my girlfriend... or not.
[FI] I waited for my little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] She's so slow... What is she doing?
[FI] I've been waiting for more than long enough.

[FI] My, my... I probably have too much free time, since 
I'm thinking of unnecessary things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't a swimsuit just pieces of cloth?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why did you take so long to put it on?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What are you saying? I don't get what you mean.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] That's why I told you not to wear a bikini.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: [FI] But you said that it would definitely be fine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, you're right. You're a kid, yet you're wearing 
such an adult swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] D-Don't stare at me so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why did you wear it if it's so embarrassing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Crying then smiling, you're such a hectic girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Now I've been told that she isn't my younger sister.

[FI] Kirino and I only learned about this just recently. 
So...

[FI] At the very least, I haven't come to terms with it 
yet.

[FI] Even though I normally interacted with her as if it 
were nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Uwah! W-What the... when did you get here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Isn't it because you were spacing out?

[FI] The fact that I didn't ask "How's what?" here 
might be because I was "thinking while spaced 
out".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It really is better to see it in person than in a 
magazine.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You're making it sound perverted, you know.
[FI] As if I'd feel that way towards my younger sister--
[FI] Wait, but she's no longer my younger sister.
[FI] This is bad, I'm suddenly conscious of her.
[FI] Kirino narrowed her eyes at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Your expression is also perverted. What are you 
thinking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] About the past. Back when you were a little brat, 
we came here with our entire family.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] When I recalled what you said that day, I felt really 
irritated, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That happened a long time ago.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, a big brother's attitude is like that towards 
his younger sister.
[FI] Yes, if it's towards a younger sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Back then, we still got along well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Now, we've reached the point where we can come 
to the beach together, just like old times.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Did we change from back then?
[FI] There's no way we didn't change.
[FI] We may be about to start changing a lot more.
